title: Foundations, Legal Compliance and Evidence Acquisition
officialTitle: Unit-1 (Teaching Hours: 12) Foundations, Legal Compliance and Acquisition
summary: Covers digital forensic science fundamentals, the eight-stage forensic lifecycle, cyber laws, statutory admissibility, search warrants, Chain of Custody documentation, cryptographic hash verification, and dead vs live forensic imaging standards.
memoryCodeMeaning: Identification, Preservation, Collection, Examination, Analysis, Documentation, Presentation, Review

topics.title: Digital Forensic Fundamentals & Eight-Stage Lifecycle
Legal Compliance, Evidence Admissibility & Cyber Law
Chain of Custody, Documentation & Hash Verification
Forensic Imaging: Live vs Dead, Physical vs Logical

title: File Systems and Artifact Collection
officialTitle: Unit-2 (Teaching Hours: 12) File Systems and Artifact Collection
summary: Details storage architecture (FAT, NTFS, ext4, APFS), metadata structures, deleted file recovery mechanisms, slack and unallocated space, signature-based data carving, Windows OS execution artifacts (Registry, LNK, Jump Lists, Prefetch), and The Sleuth Kit (TSK) command analysis.
memoryCodeMeaning: File Systems, Deleted Files, Carving, Windows Artifacts, Tools (TSK & Autopsy)

topics.title: File Systems Architecture, Metadata & Allocation
Deleted File Recovery, Slack Space & Data Carving
Windows Artifacts: Registry, LNK, Jump Lists & Prefetch
Autopsy & The Sleuth Kit (mmls, fsstat, fls, istat, icat)

title: Advanced Volatile Analysis and Network Artifacts
officialTitle: Unit-3 (Teaching Hours: 12) Advanced Volatile Analysis and Network Artifacts
summary: Examines volatile RAM triage, memory forensics with Volatility Framework, hidden processes and rootkit detection, event log correlation, Super Timeline synthesis, network traffic extraction (PCAP vs NetFlow), email artifacts (PST/OST), and multi-cloud forensic challenges.
memoryCodeMeaning: Live Investigation, Memory Forensics, Timeline Correlation, Artifacts (Email/Browser), Network Analysis

topics.title: Live Triage & Volatile Memory Preservation
Memory Forensics: Volatility Framework & Process Tree
Super Timelines & Normalized Event Log Correlation
Network Forensics: PCAP vs NetFlow, Browser & Cloud

title: Specialized Device Forensics
summary: Explores mobile device security architectures (Android vs iOS sandbox), extraction paradigms (logical, file system, physical), smartphone artifacts (SMS, calls, app SQLite databases, GPS geotags), embedded firmware acquisition, IoT forensics (smart CCTV, sensors), and privacy safeguards.
memoryCodeMeaning: Mobile OS Architecture, Acquisition Methods, Device Data, IoT Forensics, Legal & Privacy Safeguards

topics.title: Android vs iOS Architecture & Security Sandboxing
Mobile Acquisition: Logical, File System & Physical
Smartphone Artifacts: SMS, Calls, SQLite & Geolocation
IoT & Embedded Forensics: Smart CCTV, Flash & Cloud Feeds

title: Case Management, Reporting and Advanced Methodologies
officialTitle: Unit-5 (Teaching Hours: 12) Case Management, Reporting and Advanced Methodologies
summary: Focuses on large-scale forensic case management, the E-Discovery Reference Model (EDRM), court-admissible forensic report drafting, expert witness testimony, cross-examination defense, digital authentication standards, biometric forensics (FAR/FRR), and NIST CFTT tool validation.
memoryCodeMeaning: Case Management (EDRM), Reporting Standards, Expert Witness & Ethics, Validation (NIST CFTT & Biometrics)

topics.title: Large-Scale Case Management & E-Discovery (EDRM)
Forensic Report Writing & Defensible Methodologies
Expert Witness Testimony, Cross-Examination & Ethics
Digital Authentication, Biometrics & Tool Validation (NIST)
